name: feature-flag-cleanup
description: Finds feature flags in code (Flipper, django-waffle, Laravel Pennant, and LaunchDarkly, Unleash or OpenFeature calls in Node), lists every call site per flag, marks likely-stale flags, and writes a safe removal plan per flag: which branch to keep, which tests to update, and the flag record to delete last. Works from code only and never calls a flag service
